items.title_ko: AI Data Center Anger Is From the ‘Fringes,’ Host Digital Chair Says
items.summary_ko: Anger over the AI buildout is coming from the “fringes,” says Shawn Matthews, chairman of Host Digital, a vertically integrated data center developer.
